description: This file defines the data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to virtual request handling in the lighttpd web server, including request states, callbacks, and request lifecycle management.

classes.name: liConCallbacks
classes.description: Structure holding callback functions for connection events such as response error handling, throttling, and connection upgrades.

classes.name: liConInfo
classes.description: Structure containing connection-related information, including addresses, SSL status, request/response streams, and statistics.

classes.name: liVRequest
classes.description: Main structure representing a virtual request, including connection info, request/response data, state, and associated streams and buffers.

methods.name: li_vrequest_new
methods.description: Creates a new virtual request object associated with a worker and connection info.

methods.name: li_vrequest_free
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a virtual request.

methods.name: li_vrequest_reset
methods.description: Resets a virtual request, optionally keeping it alive for reuse.

methods.name: li_vrequest_start
methods.description: Initializes or resets fields of a virtual request for a new request cycle.

methods.name: li_vrequest_handle_request_headers
methods.description: Marks that all request headers have been received.

methods.name: li_vrequest_update_stats_in
methods.description: Updates incoming data statistics for the request.

methods.name: li_vrequest_update_stats_out
methods.description: Updates outgoing data statistics for the request.

methods.name: li_vrequest_wait_for_request_body
methods.description: Checks if the request body is present or should be waited for.

methods.name: li_vrequest_handle_direct
methods.description: Marks the request as fully handled directly.

methods.name: li_vrequest_is_handled
methods.description: Checks if the request has already been handled.

methods.name: li_vrequest_handle_indirect
methods.description: Handles the request over time via an indirect method.

methods.name: li_vrequest_indirect_connect
methods.description: Signals that the backend connection is ready for indirect requests.

methods.name: li_vrequest_indirect_headers_ready
methods.description: Indicates that all response headers/status code are received for an indirect request.

methods.name: li_vrequest_connection_upgrade
methods.description: Handles connection upgrade requests.

methods.name: li_vrequest_error
methods.description: Signals an internal error in the request handling process.

methods.name: li_vrequest_backend_overloaded
methods.description: Indicates the backend is overloaded.

methods.name: li_vrequest_backend_dead
methods.description: Indicates the backend is dead.

methods.name: li_vrequest_backend_error
methods.description: Handles backend errors.

methods.name: li_vrequest_backend_finished
methods.description: Marks the backend request as finished.

methods.name: li_vrequest_state_machine
methods.description: Advances the state machine for the virtual request.

methods.name: li_vrequest_joblist_append
methods.description: Appends the request to the job list for processing.

methods.name: li_vrequest_get_ref
methods.description: Gets a reference to the request's job.

methods.name: li_vrequest_redirect
methods.description: Handles request redirection.

methods.name: li_vrequest_redirect_directory
methods.description: Handles directory redirection.
